verdict.rationale: Stagehand is a code SDK for TypeScript, Python, and Go. The docs say that "v4 has no autonomous loop, you are already writing the orchestration," so developers compose multi-step sequences of act/extract/observe calls in code rather than one-shot prompts. Repeatability is backed by caching, self-healing selectors, and converting agent-discovered workflows into deterministic scripts. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of loop, conditional, and parameterization patterns (these are only implied by host-language control flow), and independent hands-on corroboration of multi-step workflow composition.
